examples.note: Montevideo — the 2 prefix identifies the metropolitan area
Mobile — 99 was an Antel range; portability means prefixes no longer identify the operator
Fixed line outside Montevideo — the 4 prefix

notes: Uruguay abolished area codes on 2010-08-29 and moved to a flat 8-digit NSN.

The trunk prefix 0 shows up on mobile numbers, which are written and dialled domestically as 09X XXX XXX; the NSN is the 8 digits after it (9X XXX XXX). Fixed lines are dialled as a plain 8 digits with no prefix.
Number portability means the leading digits of a mobile number no longer indicate the operator.
sources: URSEC — Unidad Reguladora de Servicios de Comunicaciones: https://www.gub.uy/unidad-reguladora-servicios-comunicaciones/
